official_repository.commit_pinned: PENDING — must be SHA-pinned before any decoder training run.
official_repository.rationale: MedSAM2 (Bowang Lab) extends SAM2 (Meta AI) for medical image segmentation. Per the START_HERE_ZH.md guide, a fixed immutable Git commit is required so every trained decoder is reproducible from the exact source tree.

source_checkout.path: PENDING — must be populated before training.
source_checkout.expected_contents: Official MedSAM2 repository with the pinned commit above.

released_pretrained_checkpoint.download_source: Released by the Bowang Lab MedSAM2 team via the official repository's release page (https://github.com/bowang-lab/MedSAM2/releases). The exact URL/asset name must be recorded before training so the SHA can be re-verified.
released_pretrained_checkpoint.note: Released MedSAM2.pt is a SAM2.1_hiera_t fine-tuned for medical segmentation. It must be used as the pretrained backbone only; per START_HERE_ZH.md, BrainWeb and HECKTOR decoders must each be retrained on their own split and cannot be passed off as 'the released checkpoint'.

decoder_checkpoints_v3_for_forensic_comp._forensic_only: These are the v3 trained decoders retained for forensic comparison only. They are NOT eligible clean_v1 inference checkpoints. clean_v1 must retrain both decoders on the new clean_v1 split.
decoder_checkpoints_v3_for_forensic_comp.audit_status: AUDIT_ONLY — these checkpoints were trained on the v3 split that the strict review invalidated. They cannot be reused for the MIA submission.

immutable_archive_uri._status: PENDING — must be filled before final validation. Per OPERATIONS_RUNBOOK.md: 'A mutable local path alone is insufficient.' Suggested URI format: institutional object-store version, DOI-backed deposit, or other immutable project location.

training_requirements_for_clean_v1.sampling: balanced across all four count levels per dataset, one joint model per dataset
training_requirements_for_clean_v1.input_subset_filter: training rows only; no validation, no test_locked
